description:
Marathon
Pinkathon Day was Celebrated by Pinkathon Ghatkopar East group on the Eastern Express Highway led by Pinkathon Ambassador of Ghatkopar East, Ms Priyanka Nambissan. Our Club supported this event which aimed to promote Health and fitness for women across all strata. It was a big PR Event as our Banners were put up while Rotarians ran with Tshirts bearing Clubs name.
